items.title: 2026-27 AAOMS officers and trustees announced
items.summary: ROSEMONT, Ill. – Charles A. Crago, DMD, MD, FACS, was introduced as the 2026-27 President of the American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS) during the 2026 AAOMS Annual Meeting in Seattle, Wash., in September. With AAOMS’s other officers and Board of Trustees, Dr. Crago assumes leadership of the professional organization representing more than 9,000 oral and maxillofacial surgeons. Dr. Crago, of…
